subject: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@bluewave.ai>, Alex Chen <alex@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)

Hi Sam / Alex —

Thanks again for confirming the customer demo next week. Before the live customer session on 2026-05-20, we want to run a short internal dry-run that focuses on steady-state throughput and the fallback behavior we discussed. Goal is to validate token throughput targets and p99 latency under the demo load so we don't hit surprises during the customer run.

Quick proposal:
- Dry-run window: 2026-05-13 13:00–14:00 PT
- Test targets: sustained 800 tokens/sec aggregate (across 4 r13 instances) and p99 response <250ms for prompt lengths <=1k tokens
- Participants: Redwood infra + BlueWave (observer)

Karthik / Marissa / Connor — can you confirm internal availability and whether these targets line up with the runbook you have? I've attached a short checklist and a BlueWave capacity matrix to help.

Attachments: throughput-dryrun-checklist.md, bluewave-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@bluewave.ai>, Alex Chen <alex@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)

Rafael — thanks. Confirming internal: I and Connor can take the infra lead for the dry-run. A couple notes from the ops side:

- The 800 tokens/sec aggregate is feasible if we run the r13x4 profile with KV cache warm. If we expect cold-starts in any scenario, p99 will spike — recommend we include a short warm-up phase (10 min) before the official measurement window.
- Can we scope the test prompts to the ‘analytics-summary’ prompt set? Those are representative of what BlueWave will use and match the token-distribution in the matrix.
- I'll bring a lightweight tracer so we can capture per-request latency and token counts.

Proposed update to schedule: 13:00–13:10 warm-up; 13:10–13:40 measurement; 13:40–13:50 analysis & quick readout.

Connor — dropping you the runbook link and my run command below.

-- Karthik
runbook: demo-runbook-v1.pdf
run command (ops): ./run_dry.sh --profile r13x4 --prompts analytics-summary --duration 30m --tracer on
From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@bluewave.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@bluewave.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)

Hi Rafael / Karthik —

Thanks for the clarity. The schedule works for us; I'll have Alex join as our technical observer. A couple asks from BlueWave side:

- Can you include a short checklist item to exercise the model fallback (to the smaller quantized variant) so we can see degraded-latency behavior and how you surface that in the console?
- Please share the calendar invite (we sometimes have people in CST).

We want to make sure procurement sees the latency SLO behavior before signing off on the Dedicated capacity commit.

Thanks,
Sam
Sr. Engineering Manager — BlueWave Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@bluewave.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 9:40 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Rafael — thanks. Confirming internal: I and Connor can take the infra lead for the dry-run. A couple notes from the ops side:

All good from my side. Two operational clarifications:

1) Observability — I'll enable the per-route dashboards and a temporary 30-day retention so we can pull traces after the run. Link will be on the invite.
2) Fallback exercise — suggest doing a short failover at 13:25 (2 min) where we throttle the primary pool to force fallback to the quantized variant. We'll mark that in the runbook so customers know when it happened.

I'll send a calendar invite for 13:00–13:50 PT with the agenda and links. Attaching the final runbook PDF for the dry-run.

Attachments: demo-runbook-v1.pdf

—Marissa
Product Ops — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Throughput dry-run + customer demo handshake (BlueWave)

Thanks everyone — final confirmation below and next steps.

Schedule (confirmed):
- Dry-run: 2026-05-13 13:00–13:50 PT (calendar invite sent)
  - 13:00–13:10 warm-up
  - 13:10–13:40 measurement (sustained 800 tokens/sec target)
  - 13:25 fallback exercise (2 min) to quantized model
  - 13:40–13:50 quick readout and action items

Deliverables for the customer demo on 2026-05-20:
- Readout deck with aggregated latency & token metrics (Marissa)
- KEYS: warm-up plan, fallback behavior notes, runbook steps (Karthik/Connor)
- Calendar invite + recording link for customer stakeholders (Rafael)

Attachments included in thread: throughput-dryrun-checklist.md, bluewave-matrix.xlsx, demo-runbook-v1.pdf

If anything changes, flag here and we'll update the calendar. Looking forward to the run — this should give procurement the confidence they need.

Best,
